properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for blocking Go-Live Without Complete IT Security Documentation
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm formal confirmation that all IT security documentation is complete prior to project go-live, ensuring: a) Submission of required project documents by the Project Team b) Continuous engagement of the IT Security team throughout the project lifecycle.
